items.topic: Sinus tarsi approach — posterior subtalar joint exposure and peroneal tendon protection
items.destination_intent: Canonical 2026 Foot & Ankle or Trauma OITE calcaneal fracture/sinus tarsi approach section; resolve the teaching page during requested filing
items.teaching_point_placement: Beside the explanation of the deep sinus tarsi working window and protection of the peroneal tendons at its inferior/posterior border; current set Q8 #Trauma20-001
items.caption_intent: Exact user-uploaded AO illustration of the deep sinus tarsi exposure of the subtalar joint. Lateral hindfoot view with heel to the left and forefoot to the right; the small lateral window permits direct visualization of the posterior subtalar articular surface. Source: AO Surgery Reference, Sinus tarsi approach to the calcaneus, section 5, figure 82_A022_i070 (https://surgeryreference.aofoundation.org/orthopedic-trauma/adult-trauma/calcaneous/approach/sinus-tarsi-approach).
